title: #IUIC #Bishop #Nathanyel7 #IsraelUnitedInChrist
segments: God told my wife and I to start a
Christian nightclub in the heart of Los
Angeles. This is going to be a fun space
for Christians to enjoy, to vibe, to
listen to Christian music, to
fellowship, just to dance. There will be
a DJ, there will be performers, there'll
be food, there will be worship, there'll
be prayer. Going to do healing and
deliverance sessions inside the club. As
you can see, this is what they Jesus
supports, right? You can't find none of
this in the Bible. All this this
foolishness, this bedy, all this stuff,
man. You cannot find this stuff in the
Bible. Go to Romansap 13 and verse 12.
The night is far spent. The day is
ahead. Let us therefore cast off the
works of darkness and let us put on the
armor of light. And that's what we need
to do. We need to put on the armor of
light. Cast off all the works of
darkness. This church, this Christian
nightclub church is straight darkness.
No truth. You ain't going to find truth
in there.
